scope: Concise retained-evidence explanation of JMdict frontier and fixture-specific proof-consumer applicability. No new execution, profiling, timing or inferred speedup. Current a300 full results remain a separate cohort.
mainFinding: The proof consumer has a measured activation opportunity in the locked VNDB component fixture:6,324,582 complete suffix proofs. It has zero proofs on locked JMdict and Jitendex. JMdict remains the priority, but these experiments do not establish a JMdict performance improvement.
whyThisMechanismIsFixtureSpecific: The consumer requires a successful full bounded byte-equality proof of the complete adjacent row suffix, including independently validated tags/rules/numeric tokens/glossary/sequence/term tags. In the fixed f28 diagnostic, the already-frozen numeric admission rejects all154,409 JMdict and73,243 Jitendex prior-streak opportunities before suffix probing. VNDB has6,324,582 complete proofs. These are workload-specific route counts, not a rule based on dictionary names.
